package.name: leia-analytics-report
package.description: Provider-free live package skeleton for generic analytics reports

no_built_in_guarantee.statement: Leia core does not provide built-in finance providers, valuation formulas, chart renderers, HTML renderers, or PDF renderers; this package declares those surfaces as external capabilities behind provider-free gates.

provider_gate.test_rule: package tests must pass with no credentials, no provider SDK imports, and no network I/O

test_gates: manifest and schema files are valid JSON and schema_version 1
provider_free is true and live_network_default is false
no provider credentials or provider SDKs are required for tests
Leia fixture execution validates finance normalizers, valuation analytics, sensitivity matrix, chart specs, report manifest, and HTML/PDF renderer contracts
artifact contracts declare planned HTML and PDF outputs without invoking a renderer
